calendar: Require complete lag and target windows against screened SPY sessions
mixture_grid: All five-expert simplex weights in steps of one third, plus uniform weights
selection: Minimize maximum validation ratio for Euclidean, Frobenius, QLIKE divergence, and long-only realized portfolio variance against HAR-DRD; tie-break on mean ratio then simpler candidates
selection_portfolio_solver: Accelerated projected gradient, 200 steps initially; increase to 1000 or 3000 until relative duality-gap bound <= 0.0001
primary_success: All three mean forecast losses and long-only portfolio variance below HAR-DRD; all four paired 95% upper confidence bounds below zero for joint statistical success
iteration_rule: Report this fixed candidate without changing its architecture or selection rule after evaluation; report all endpoints even when it fails
qualification: The available 2024-2026 evaluation outcomes have been inspected previously. This is causal retrospective model evaluation, not fresh confirmation or numerical replication of the paper.
